messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=inference-api-prod | severity=high | symptom=5xx surge in eu-west-1. Incident: PD-8632. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-8632 :rotating_light:

jess: Acked in PD, taking first-line. Opening a short bridge for triage. Who's got quick telemetry?

akshay: I can grab logs. Seeing spike in 502/504s starting ~00:35 UTC. Error rate ~10x on /v1/embeddings from eu-west-1.

marta: Noted — I see routing flaps hitting dedicated pool `eu-west-1-gpu-pool-2`. There was a canary deploy at 00:30 that touched quantized runtime layers.

jess: Good context. I'm claiming ownership. @akshay please hand me any tracer ids you find. I'll open bridge and notify support. Bridge: https://zoom.example/314159 (short)

incident-bot: PagerDuty: ack recorded by jess (on-call). Escalations suppressed.

samir: Quick health check run: `kubectl get pods -n inference | egrep 'eu-west-1-gpu-pool'`
```
pod/gpu-worker-12   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   3   2m
pod/gpu-worker-13   1/1   Running            0   12m
```

liz: Customer impact: Support shows ~30 distinct customers reporting failures in last 10m. Most are short-lived retries but some unhappy customers. SLO error rate crossing warning.

ajshay: (typo correction) -- ack, meant @akshay :)

akshay: Traces: lots of `kv-cache` evictions flagged, GC pressure around the quantized runtime shard. Example trace id: `trace-0b3a`. Attaching brief log snippet: \"error=rpc: context canceled\" repeated.

jess: Thanks. @marta can you flip routing to the CPU fallback variant for eu region while we triage the gpu pool? That should reduce customer-facing errors quickly.

marta: Initiating route fallback now — switching traffic to `inference-cpu-fallback-v1`. Pushing policy change; ETA ~90s.

samir: Nodes show OOM/kills on gpu-12 just before the crash loops. I suspect a memory regression in the new runtime.

marta: Reroute applied. Monitoring... errors down ~60% in the last 30s.

jess: Excellent. I'll send a brief PSA to support and engineering leads. Summary: PD page fired -> ack by jess -> team applied routing fallback -> errors decreasing. Will escalate to rollback if errors rebound.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: no new escalations while acknowledged.

liz: Draft PSA for support: \"We observed a transient 5xx surge impacting embeddings in eu-west-1 starting ~00:35 UTC. Traffic has been rerouted to a fallback backend; errors are decreasing. We will follow up if we perform a rollback. ETA next update 00:38 UTC.\" Want me to post?

jess: Post it, please. Add note to include affected customer count and link to bridge.

liz: Posted to #support with update and bridge link.

akshay: Root cause hypothesis: memory regression in quantized kernel path after the canary. I'll gather heap/gc metrics and a reproducible run.

marta: If confirmed, we should rollback the canary and block future canaries until fix. I'll prepare the rollback PR and standby for approval.

samir: For the bridge: `top` on gpu-12 shows memory climb to 96% right before oom. Collecting dmesg/oom logs now.

jess: Great work. I'll keep status pings every 2 minutes. Next update at 00:38 UTC. If anyone takes over ownership, ping here and update PD.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: status change recorded — acknowledged by jess.

(00:38 UTC) jess: Update: errors continue to trend down after fallback. We have a mitigation path. Action items: akshay collect metrics+traces, marta prepare rollback PR, samir gather node oom logs, liz coordinate customer comms. I'll keep this thread open and will escalate to SRE lead if we see >10% errors again. :thumbsup:
